text: Refunds may be requested within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and proof of purchase is required. Exceptions require manager approval.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Tracking becomes available after dispatch.
Electronic products include a one year limited warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and unauthorized repairs are excluded.
Account holders may request a copy of personal data and ask support to correct inaccurate profile information. Data export requests are verified.
Use multi-factor authentication, rotate compromised credentials and report suspicious sign-in activity to the security team.
New learners complete profile setup, choose a learning path and finish the foundation assessment before advanced modules unlock.
Uploaded learning documents are retained according to the workspace retention policy. Deletion requests remove active indexes and scheduled backups expire under the backup lifecycle.
Document access is limited by tenant membership, owner permissions and explicit document grants. Tenant administrators can audit access events.
